summary: Separated fixed Gemini policy from synthetic user data at the SDK role boundary, preserved the combined 128 KiB zero-call guard, and added a reproducible Python 3.12 hash lock plus a required strict dependency-audit gate with all applicable advisories resolved.

tests.notes: CPython 3.12.14 and pip-tools 7.5.0 generated the 70-package lock with 973 SHA-256 artifact hashes. A clean Python 3.12 installation from requirements.lock passed pip check. pip-audit 2.10.1 initially failed closed on applicable python-dotenv 1.1.1 and Starlette 0.47.3 advisories; exact direct pins were updated to python-dotenv 1.2.2 and FastAPI 0.141.1, resolving Starlette 1.6.0, after which the strict no-ignore audit reported no known vulnerabilities. All 48 backend and 12 agentic tests passed without application credentials or a live Vertex AI call; project, contract, full repository verification, security-only verification, diff-hygiene, and backend-scope checks passed.

notes_for_next_agent: The Google Gen AI SDK now receives the immutable SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION only through GenerateContentConfig.system_instruction; contents is exactly the fixed SUPPLIED_SYNTHETIC_DATA_JSON label plus canonical JSON, and the combined UTF-8 byte limit is enforced before invocation.

Focused fake-client tests inspect actual SDK arguments and prove adversarial instruction-like data remains user content, the policy is absent from user content, environment sentinels and tools are absent, and an over-limit combined request makes zero provider calls.

requirements-agent.txt documents the exact clean Python 3.12/pip-tools 7.5.0 regeneration command and exactly pins pip-audit 2.10.1; requirements.lock SHA-256 is c9c96628d193ac836dfde12e51137549da155158c35639cdbb8f111403969420.

All three Python-installing GitHub Actions workflows install only requirements.lock with --require-hashes, and .ai/project.json requires the same strict, hash-enforced, no-resolution, no-ignore audit used by local security verification.

No contract, frontend, database, dataset, deterministic-rule, endpoint, model-authority, credential, tool, retry, or fallback behavior changed; independent testing and integrated verification remain orchestration gates.
